title: GlobalSettings
description: Platform baseline applied to all clans. Managed by the platform team.

bootstrap.description: Required. Script under hooks/ that the SessionStart hook runs. It downloads and installs the agent config, then runs the SessionStart scripts. The hook downloads the script first when a repository does not have it.

agent.description: Optional. The main-thread agent, set as `agent` in every settings.json. The bootstrap installs agents/<agent>/instructions.md as .claude/agents/<agent>.md, and global/CLAUDE.md, published as CLAUDE.md, becomes the shared rules in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Both files must exist in agent-registry/.

allow.description: Allowed tool invocations for all clans.

SessionStart.description: Global session-start hook scripts run once per session for all clans.

Stop.description: Global stop scripts, run when Claude finishes a turn. Exit code 2 blocks the stop.

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the script. Shell-quoted in the generated command.

script.description: Path to hook script relative to agent-registry/global/. Must be a direct child of hooks/ (no subdirectories) and end in .sh (run with bash) or .mjs (run with node)

Commands.description: Global slash command files. Must exist under agent-registry/global/commands/

matcher.description: Claude Code tool name pattern (e.g. Bash, Write|Edit).

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the script. Shell-quoted in the generated command.

script.description: Path to hook script relative to agent-registry/global/. Must be a direct child of hooks/ (no subdirectories) and end in .sh (run with bash) or .mjs (run with node)
